newsitem.title: USA: Microelectronic says FY '96 charge, loss.
newsitem.headline: Microelectronic says FY '96 charge, loss.

text.p: Microelectronic Packaging Inc said Monday it expects to make a charge of $30 million to its 1996 operating results.
The charge will result in a "significant loss" for the full year 1996, it said.

The charge and the resulting loss stem from corporate changes that include liquidating the company's MPM Singapore Pte Ltd subsidiary effective immediately and the continuation of a previously announced restructuring of another Singapore subsidiary, Microelectronic Packaging (S) Pte Ltd, it said.

"These actions will place the company and serveral of its subsidiaries in default of its and its subsidiaries' debt and other signficant obligations, all of which may have a material advsere effect on the company," it said.
The company said it is currently negotiating with various creditors, lenders, equity holders and others in its two offshore subsidiaries and in the U.S. parent itself.
It said it is the guarantor of most of the obligations in the subsidiaries and it expects an "acceptable resolution" of the problems.
It added all possibilities for dealing with those parties are being pursued, including the possibility of converting significant portions of debt into equity.
It said, however, that it will end 1996 with a negative net worth which might affect its listing on the Nasdaq.
It said its board is completing a review of its business plan, operations and other oportunities for future growth.
